sql:
WITH __segments AS (
  SELECT
    segment,
    segment_name,
    value_tier,
    behavior_segment AS buying_style,
    behavior_name AS buying_style_name,
    customers,
    mean_p_active AS p_buys_again,

  FROM customer_segmentation.analyst.segments
), c4 AS (
  SELECT
    segment,
    segment_name,
    buying_style,
    buying_style_name,
    customers,
    p_buys_again,
    median_recency_days,
    median_orders,
    expected_orderers
  FROM __segments
  WHERE
    value_tier = 'C4'
), weighted AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(customers * p_buys_again) / NULLIF(SUM(customers), 0) AS weighted_p_buys_again_c4
  FROM c4
)
SELECT
  c4.segment,
  c4.segment_name,
  c4.buying_style,
  c4.buying_style_name,
  c4.customers,
  c4.p_buys_again,
  c4.median_recency_days,
  c4.median_orders,
  c4.expected_orderers,
  weighted.weighted_p_buys_again_c4
FROM c4
CROSS JOIN weighted
